item.title: 5 HDFC Bank employees arrested in Kashmir for financial fraud

item.title: Stock markets open lower amid weakness in IT, Services shares

item.description: KATRA: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Narayana Superspeciality Hospital (SMVDNSH), Kakryal, District Reasi, has been granted Provisional Accreditation by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) to commence the DNB – Hospital Administration (Post MBBS) programme.
